skill_name: Describe the key features of the poem “The Rime of the Ancient Mariner.”
workflow: The Rime of the Ancient Mariner is a poem by Samuel Taylor Coleridge written in 1798. It tells the story of a mariner who has broken the code of conduct of a sailor by killing an albatross, and is forced to wander the sea from experience to experience in search of penitence. The poem closely follows the idea of the supernatural, with themes of death, the supernatural, and redemption.
